Import and preprocess data from DATASUS with intelligent caching

Source: R/sus_data_import.R
sus_data_import.Rd

This function acts as a wrapper for microdatasus::fetch_datasus, simplifying the download and reading of data from Brazilian public health information systems (SIM, SINAN, SIH, SIA, CNES, SINASC). It includes parallel processing, caching, and user-friendly CLI feedback.

Usage

sus_data_import(
  uf = NULL,
  region = NULL,
  year,
  month = NULL,
  system,
  backend = "arrow",
  city = NULL,
  municipality_code = NULL,
  use_cache = TRUE,
  cache_dir = "~/.climasus4r_cache/data",
  force_redownload = FALSE,
  filter_residence_uf = TRUE,
  parallel = FALSE,
  workers = 4,
  lang = "pt",
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

uf

Character scalar or vector of two-letter state codes (upper case), e.g. "AM" or c("SP", "RJ"); "all" is also accepted by the validation (all states; no UF filter is applied to the result). Valid codes: AC, AL, AP, AM, BA, CE, DF, ES, GO, MA, MT, MS, MG, PA, PB, PR, PE, PI, RJ, RN, RS, RO, RR, SC, SP, SE, TO. Ignored (with a warning) when region is supplied. Invalid codes abort with an error. Either uf or region is required (default NULL). For national SINAN systems a single national file is downloaded per year and then filtered to the requested UF(s).

region

Character scalar (a single name, not a vector) selecting a predefined group of states, e.g. "norte", "amazonia_legal", "matopiba". Case-insensitive; Portuguese keys and the English/Spanish aliases (e.g. "north", "legal_amazon", "sur", "semiarido") are accepted. Takes precedence over uf. Default NULL. An unrecognised name aborts with an error. Available regions:

IBGE Macro-regions:

  • "norte": c("AC", "AP", "AM", "PA", "RO", "RR", "TO")

  • "nordeste": c("AL", "BA", "CE", "MA", "PB", "PE", "PI", "RN", "SE")

  • "centro_oeste": c("DF", "GO", "MT", "MS")

  • "sudeste": c("ES", "MG", "RJ", "SP")

  • "sul": c("PR", "RS", "SC")

Biomes (Ecological Borders):

  • "amazonia_legal": c("AC", "AP", "AM", "PA", "RO", "RR", "MT", "MA", "TO")

  • "mata_atlantica": c("AL", "BA", "CE", "ES", "GO", "MA", "MG", "MS", "PB", "PE", "PI", "PR", "RJ", "RN", "RS", "SC", "SE", "SP")

  • "caatinga": c("AL", "BA", "CE", "MA", "PB", "PE", "PI", "RN", "SE", "MG")

  • "cerrado": c("BA", "DF", "GO", "MA", "MG", "MS", "MT", "PA", "PI", "PR", "RO", "SP", "TO")

  • "pantanal": c("MT", "MS")

  • "pampa": c("RS")

Hydrography & Climate:

  • "bacia_amazonia": c("AC", "AM", "AP", "MT", "PA", "RO", "RR")

  • "bacia_sao_francisco": c("AL", "BA", "DF", "GO", "MG", "PE", "SE")

  • "bacia_parana": c("GO", "MG", "MS", "PR", "SP")

  • "bacia_tocantins": c("GO", "MA", "PA", "TO")

  • "semi_arido": c("AL", "BA", "CE", "MA", "PB", "PE", "PI", "RN", "SE", "MG")

Health, Agriculture & Geopolitics:

  • "matopiba": c("MA", "TO", "PI", "BA")

  • "arco_desmatamento": c("RO", "AC", "AM", "PA", "MT", "MA")

  • "dengue_hyperendemic": c("GO", "MS", "MT", "PR", "RJ", "SP")

  • "sudene": c("AL", "BA", "CE", "MA", "PB", "PE", "PI", "RN", "SE", "MG", "ES")

  • "fronteira_brasil": c("AC", "AM", "AP", "MT", "MS", "PA", "PR", "RO", "RR", "RS", "SC")

year

Required. Numeric (4-digit) year(s): a scalar (2023), a range (2020:2025), or an explicit vector (c(2020, 2022, 2024)). Every element is downloaded as a separate file, so c(2020, 2024) means exactly those two years, not the range 2020-2024; use 2020:2024 for a range. Character years that coerce to numbers ("2023") are passed through as.numeric(). Available years depend on the DATASUS system and are not validated here; a combination with no published file is reported as "no data"/failed and skipped. The total number of downloads is length(uf) * length(year) * length(month) (months only for monthly systems).

month

Integer scalar or vector with months 1-12, e.g. 1, 1:6, c(1, 7) (exactly January and July). Required (non-NULL) for the monthly systems SIH, CNES and SIA; the function aborts otherwise. Values outside 1-12 abort. For annual systems (SIM, SINAN, SINASC) a non-NULL value triggers a warning and has no effect on the download. The same months are applied to every year in year. Default NULL.

system

Required. Character scalar with exactly one system code from the list below (case-sensitive; vectors are not supported). An invalid value aborts and suggests close matches. Available systems:

Mortality Systems (SIM - Mortality Information System):

  • "SIM-DO": Death certificates (Declaracoes de Obito) - Complete dataset

  • "SIM-DOFET": Fetal deaths (Obitos Fetais)

  • "SIM-DOEXT": External causes deaths (Obitos por Causas Externas)

  • "SIM-DOINF": Infant deaths (Obitos Infantis)

  • "SIM-DOMAT": Maternal deaths (Obitos Maternos)

Hospitalization Systems (SIH - Hospital Information System):

  • "SIH-RD": Hospital Admission Authorizations (AIH - Autorizacoes de Internacao Hospitalar)

  • "SIH-RJ": Hospital Admission Authorizations - Rio de Janeiro specific

  • "SIH-SP": Hospital Admission Authorizations - Sao Paulo specific

  • "SIH-ER": Emergency Room Records (Prontuarios de Emergencia)

Notifiable Diseases (SINAN - Notifiable Diseases Information System):

  • "SINAN-DENGUE": Dengue fever cases

  • "SINAN-CHIKUNGUNYA": Chikungunya cases

  • "SINAN-ZIKA": Zika virus cases

  • "SINAN-MALARIA": Malaria cases

  • "SINAN-CHAGAS": Chagas disease cases

  • "SINAN-LEISHMANIOSE-VISCERAL": Visceral leishmaniasis cases

  • "SINAN-LEISHMANIOSE-TEGUMENTAR": Cutaneous leishmaniasis cases

  • "SINAN-LEPTOSPIROSE": Leptospirosis cases

Outpatient Systems (SIA - Outpatient Information System):

  • "SIA-AB": Primary Care (Atencao Basica)

  • "SIA-ABO": Dental Procedures (Procedimentos Odontologicos)

  • "SIA-ACF": Pharmaceutical Assistance (Assistencia Farmaceutica)

  • "SIA-AD": High Complexity (Alta Complexidade/Diferenciada)

  • "SIA-AN": Home Care (Atencao Domiciliar)

  • "SIA-AM": Medical Specialties (Ambulatorio de Especialidades)

  • "SIA-AQ": Strategic Actions (Acoes Estrategicas)

  • "SIA-AR": Regulation (Regulacao)

  • "SIA-ATD": Urgency/Emergency (Urgencia/Emergencia)

  • "SIA-PA": Hospital Outpatient (Procedimentos Ambulatoriais em Hospital)

  • "SIA-PS": Psychosocial Care (Atencao Psicossocial)

  • "SIA-SAD": Specialized Care (Atencao Especializada)

Health Establishments (CNES - National Health Establishment Registry):

  • "CNES-LT": Beds (Leitos)

  • "CNES-ST": Health Professionals (Profissionais de Saude)

  • "CNES-DC": Equipment (Equipamentos) - Detailed

  • "CNES-EQ": Equipment (Equipamentos) - Summary

  • "CNES-SR": Specialized Services (Servicos Especializados)

  • "CNES-HB": Hospital Beds (Leitos Hospitalares)

  • "CNES-PF": Health Professionals Detailed (Pessoal Fisico)

  • "CNES-EP": Teaching Participants (Participantes do Ensino)

  • "CNES-RC": Hospital Class (Classificacao Hospitalar)

  • "CNES-IN": Hospital Indicators (Indicadores Hospitalares)

  • "CNES-EE": Educational Entities (Entidades de Ensino)

  • "CNES-EF": Teaching Facilities (Instalacoes de Ensino)

  • "CNES-GM": Management/Support (Gestao e Apoio)

Live Births (SINASC - Live Birth Information System):

  • "SINASC": Live Birth Declarations (Declaracoes de Nascidos Vivos)

backend

Character scalar, "arrow" (default) or "tibble".

  • "arrow": each UF/year/month file is cached as Parquet and the result is a lazy Arrow dataset (class climasus_dataset) that is not loaded into memory; use dplyr::collect() to materialise it. If the Arrow path fails, a warning is issued and the function falls back to "tibble".

  • "tibble": data is fully loaded into memory as a climasus_df (cached as RDS). Simpler, but may be slow or fail for large datasets.

Any value other than "arrow" uses the tibble path.

city

Character vector of municipality names (e.g., "Porto Velho", c("Manaus", "Belem")) or 6/7-digit code strings. Case-insensitive; accents are normalised; the search is restricted to the requested uf when possible. Unknown names are skipped with a warning and fuzzy suggestions. Combined (union) with municipality_code. Applied after the download to the combined data. Default NULL (no municipality filter).

municipality_code

Character or numeric vector of 6- or 7-digit IBGE municipality codes, e.g. c(110020, 1302603). Combined (union) with city; both the 6-digit (DATASUS) and 7-digit (IBGE) forms of each code are matched. Default NULL.

use_cache

Logical scalar, default TRUE. Reuse files already downloaded to cache_dir. The cache key is system + UF + year + month (national SINAN files are keyed without UF). Files older than 30 days are considered stale and re-downloaded.

cache_dir

Character scalar, directory for cached files (~ is expanded; created if missing). Default "~/.climasus4r_cache/data". The arrow backend stores Parquet files under cache_dir/raw.

force_redownload

Logical scalar, default FALSE. If TRUE, ignores the cache and downloads everything again (useful for corrupted or outdated files).

filter_residence_uf

Logical. For state-level systems (SIM, SIH, SIA, SINASC), keep only records whose municipality code belongs to the requested uf (default TRUE). Set to FALSE to keep every record in the state file, e.g. SIH admissions of patients living in another state. Needed to build residence-based national series, where an admission in one state must be assigned to the patient's state of residence. Has no effect on national systems (SINAN).

parallel

Logical scalar, default FALSE. If TRUE, download multiple UF/year/month combinations in parallel (via future). A warning is issued if workers exceeds the number of detected cores.

workers

Integer, default 4. Number of parallel workers; only used when parallel = TRUE.

lang

Character scalar: "pt" (default), "en" or "es". Language of console messages; any other value aborts.

verbose

Logical scalar, default TRUE. Print progress (cache hits, downloads, filters).

Value

With backend = "arrow" (default): a lazy Arrow dataset of class climasus_dataset (not in memory; dplyr::collect() returns a climasus_df). With backend = "tibble" (or after fallback): a climasus_df tibble combining all UFs/years/months with the original DATASUS columns (as returned by microdatasus). sus_meta is set to stage = "import", type = "raw".

Note: large datasets (especially SIA and SIH) may require a lot of memory (1 GB+ for national annual data); prefer the arrow backend.

Details

Data Sources

All data is sourced from the Brazilian Ministry of Health's DATASUS portal (http://datasus.saude.gov.br).

Caching System

One file is cached per system/UF/year(/month) combination (Parquet for backend = "arrow", RDS for "tibble"). Cached files older than 30 days are re-downloaded.

Pipeline position

First step of the pipeline (stage "import"). Next: sus_data_clean_encoding() and sus_data_standardize().

Year and month semantics

year and month are expanded as a full grid with uf: year = 2020:2022, month = 1:3 downloads 9 files per UF. Vectors are taken literally (c(2020, 2024) = two years).

Residence filter

For state-level systems, rows whose municipality code does not belong to the requested UF are dropped unless filter_residence_uf = FALSE.

Parallel Processing

With parallel = TRUE, combinations are downloaded concurrently. For large downloads consider more workers if cores and memory allow.

References

Brazilian Ministry of Health. DATASUS. http://datasus.saude.gov.br

SALDANHA, Raphael de Freitas; BASTOS, Ronaldo Rocha; BARCELLOS, Christovam. Microdatasus: pacote para download e pre-processamento de microdados do Departamento de Informatica do SUS (DATASUS). Cad. Saude Publica, Rio de Janeiro , v. 35, n. 9, e00032419, 2019. Available from https://doi.org/10.1590/0102-311x00032419.

See also

  • sus_data_clean_encoding(), sus_data_standardize(), sus_data_read()

  • Official DATASUS documentation: http://datasus.saude.gov.br

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Basic example: Mortality data for Rio de Janeiro in 2022
df_sim <- sus_data_import(
  uf = "RJ", 
  year = 2022, 
  system = "SIM-DO",
  use_cache = TRUE
)

# Dengue cases for two states with parallel processing
df_dengue <- sus_data_import(
  uf = c("SP", "MG"), 
  year = 2023, 
  system = "SINAN-DENGUE",
  parallel = TRUE,
  workers = 3
)

# Hospitalizations with monthly specification
df_hospital <- sus_data_import(
  uf = "SP",
  year = 2024,
  month = 1:6,  # January to June
  system = "SIH-RD",
  verbose = TRUE
)

# Non-contiguous years: exactly 2020 and 2024 (NOT 2020-2024)
df_two <- sus_data_import(uf = "AM", year = c(2020, 2024), system = "SIM-DO")

# A whole region instead of uf
df_n <- sus_data_import(region = "norte", year = 2022, system = "SIM-DO")

# Force re-download ignoring cache
df_births <- sus_data_import(
  uf = "BA",
  year = 2020:2022,
  system = "SINASC",
  use_cache = TRUE,
  force_redownload = TRUE  # Refresh cached data
)
} # }
